quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #11
										  					
  

35 Questions • Passing Score 30

questions.question: You are approaching a railroad crossing with flashing signals. What should you do?

options.text: Stop and look for a train.
Slow down and look for a train.
Look for a train, then speed up.
Do what the vehicle ahead of you does.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and look for a train.
questions.explanation: Stop at least 15 feet from the railroad tracks when you see flashing signals or lowered gates. Listen and look for trains before crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road has multiple curves coming up.

questions.question: What does a solid yellow arrow traffic signal mean?

options.text: Is never used as a traffic signal.
Has the same meaning as a circular yellow traffic light.
Means that drivers may turn in the direction indicated by the arrow.
Tells drivers that a green arrow is about to be shown.

questions.correctAnswerText: Has the same meaning as a circular yellow traffic light.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow arrow means the same thing as a yellow light. Slow down and prepare to stop.

questions.question: Drivers should keep a safe distance from bicyclists.
questions.correctAnswerText: TRUE
questions.explanation: Always leave enough space between your vehicle and a cyclist to keep them safe.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.correctAnswerText: Intersection.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a road is crossing ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road surface is slippery when it rains.

questions.question: You see a "Merging Traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: When it is safe, move to another lane to make room for traffic entering the freeway.

questions.question: You approach a railroad crossing with a crossbuck sign but no gates or flashing lights. What should you do?

options.text: Approach all tracks with extreme caution and cross only when you know that there is no train coming.
Turn your radio down to hear if there may be an approaching train.
Only continue once cleared to do so by a flagger, if applicable.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Be very careful at all railroad crossings. Listen for trains, look both ways, and obey any flaggers present.

questions.question: When entering a freeway, what is the best way to merge?

options.text: Proceed slowly while waiting for an opening.
Accelerate to a speed that is faster than the speed of traffic.
Turn on your hazard lights until safely on the freeway.
Accelerate to the speed of freeway traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Accelerate to the speed of freeway traffic.
questions.explanation: Speed up on the on-ramp to match freeway traffic speed so you can blend in smoothly and safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Pedestrian crossing.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that pedestrians may cross the road here. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: When you are driving in a travel lane on the road:

options.text: You can stop to let passengers out.
You can stop to look up an address.
You can make a U-turn or back up if you miss the freeway entrance ramp.
Do not stop for any reason. Keep driving until you can safely pull off the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not stop for any reason. Keep driving until you can safely pull off the road.
questions.explanation: Never stop in a travel lane. Keep driving until you can safely pull off the road. If you miss your turn or exit, do not back up. Go to the next turn or exit instead.

questions.question: Two solid yellow lines on the road mean:

options.text: Both directions of traffic can pass.
Passing is allowed on top of a hill.
Passing is allowed during the day only.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing is not allowed.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines mean traffic on the other side is going the opposite direction. Never cross two solid yellow lines to pass, from either direction.

questions.question: You notice a problem with your vehicle that could affect safe driving. What should you do?

options.text: Fix the problem as soon as possible.
Fix the problem when you have money.

questions.correctAnswerText: Fix the problem as soon as possible.
questions.explanation: Fix any vehicle problem that affects safe driving as soon as possible. Do not drive the vehicle until it is fixed.

questions.question: When should you use your horn?

options.text: When you see a child about to run into the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you see a child about to run into the street.
questions.explanation: Use your horn to warn drivers or pedestrians who do not see you. For example, honk if a child is about to run into the street in front of your vehicle.

questions.question: HOV lanes are not reserved for:
questions.correctAnswerText: Tractor-trailers.
questions.explanation: HOV lanes are reserved for buses, carpools, vehicles with multiple passengers, motorcycles, and certain clean fuel vehicles. Tractor-trailers are not allowed.

questions.question: When driving where children are playing, you should expect them to:

options.text: Know when it is safe to cross the street.
Wait at the curb before crossing the street.
Run out in front of you without looking.
Not cross the street unless an adult is with them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Run out in front of you without looking.
questions.explanation: Always slow down and be careful around children. They may not understand danger and may run in front of your vehicle without looking.

questions.question: Zero tolerance is:

options.text: A law that makes it illegal for drivers under 21 to drive with a blood alcohol level of 0.02 percent or higher.

questions.correctAnswerText: A law that makes it illegal for drivers under 21 to drive with a blood alcohol level of 0.02 percent or higher.
questions.explanation: For drivers over 21, the legal alcohol limit is 0.08 percent. For drivers under 21, the limit is 0.02 percent or higher, which is illegal.

questions.question: Yield means stop if you cannot safely merge into traffic.
questions.correctAnswerText: True
questions.explanation: When you must yield, you must also stop if you cannot safely merge into traffic.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.correctAnswerText: No U-turn.
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: You have the right-of-way when turning left on which traffic signal?
questions.correctAnswerText: A green arrow pointing left
questions.explanation: A green left arrow means you can turn left in that direction. Traffic coming toward you must stop.

questions.question: Orange signs tell drivers about:
questions.correctAnswerText: Work zones.
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn drivers about work zones. These signs are diamond-shaped with black letters or symbols. They alert drivers that workers are on or near the highway.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.correctAnswerText: Curve ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about upcoming road hazards. This sign warns you that the road curves ahead.

questions.question: When driving near a motorcycle, you must:

options.text: Allow the motorcycle to use a complete lane.
Drive on the shoulder beside the motorcycle.
Allow the motorcycle to use only half of a lane.
Pass using the same lane as the motorcycle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Allow the motorcycle to use a complete lane.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles are full-size vehicles with the same road rights as other vehicles. Give motorcycles a full lane width. They need room to move safely, even if the lane looks big enough to share.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Be prepared for a sharp left turn ahead.
Watch for people crossing your path.
Take a detour to avoid dangerous driving conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a detour to avoid dangerous driving conditions.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a change in traffic pattern or route ahead due to a work zone. Follow the detour route shown.

questions.question: The best safety restraints in a crash are:

options.text: Only a lap and shoulder belt.
Both a lap/shoulder belt and an airbag.

questions.correctAnswerText: Both a lap/shoulder belt and an airbag.
questions.explanation: Safety belts double your chances of surviving a crash and prevent serious injury. Airbags work best with safety belts during a front-end crash. Always wear both shoulder and lap belts.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Merge. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves right ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown on the sign (in this case, 35 mph).

questions.question: What colors are highway exit distance signs?
questions.correctAnswerText: Green with white letters
questions.explanation: Destination and direction signs are green with white letters or symbols.

questions.question: A work zone:

options.text: Is marked with black and white signs.
Does not require a driver to slow down and pay extra attention.

questions.correctAnswerText: May be moving or stationary.
questions.explanation: Work zones can be stationary or moving (like vehicles striping, mowing, or removing snow). Orange signs with black letters mark work zones. Always slow down and pay extra attention in work zones.

questions.question: A steady green light means you:

options.text: Must slow down and prepare to stop.
Must stop and check for oncoming traffic before proceeding.
May drive through the intersection if the road is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: May drive through the intersection if the road is clear.
questions.explanation: A steady green light means you can drive through the intersection if it is safe. You may also turn right or left unless a sign says no. Always yield to other vehicles and pedestrians when turning.

questions.question: The best way to avoid losing control on wet roads is to increase your speed.
questions.correctAnswerText: False
questions.explanation: On wet roads, your tires can ride up on water and lose grip. This is called hydroplaning. Slow down when driving in wet conditions to avoid losing control.

questions.question: Drivers do not have to yield to pedestrians in a crosswalk.
questions.correctAnswerText: False
questions.explanation: Drivers must stop and yield when a pedestrian is in a marked crosswalk. Drivers must also yield to pedestrians in unmarked crosswalks on their side of the road when there are no traffic signals.

questions.question: A red traffic light means you must:
questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: A red light means you must stop before entering the intersection, at any stop line, and before entering any crosswalk.

questions.question: You are on a two-lane road with no bike lanes and you see a bicyclist ahead. What is the safest way to pass?

options.text: Slow down and wait for oncoming traffic to clear. Then pass the bicyclist with plenty of space between you.
Continue driving straight. The bicyclist must get out of your way.
Do not pass until you reach a traffic signal or stop sign.
Honk to let the bicyclist know you are about to pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and wait for oncoming traffic to clear. Then pass the bicyclist with plenty of space between you.
questions.explanation: Pass a bicyclist the way you would pass any vehicle. Give at least 3 feet of space on normal roads or 5 feet on faster roads. Do not honk unnecessarily, as it may startle the rider and cause a crash.

questions.question: Before changing lanes on a highway, you should:

options.text: Check your mirrors and blind spots.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check your mirrors and blind spots.
questions.explanation: Check your rearview and side mirrors to see if anyone is passing you. Also look over your shoulder to check for vehicles in your blind spot.

questions.question: A red arrow on a traffic light means:

options.text: A driver must proceed slowly through the intersection.
A driver must stop and then proceed when the way is clear.
A driver must stop and wait until the light turns green or a green arrow appears.
A driver may turn in the direction the red arrow is pointing.

questions.correctAnswerText: A driver must stop and wait until the light turns green or a green arrow appears.
questions.explanation: Unless a sign says otherwise, a red arrow means drivers must come to a complete stop and stay stopped until a green light or green arrow appears.
